tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the sprite library by keyword, category, or get a random sprite. Returns a text listing of matching sprites.

query.description: Search keyword (matches id, name, category, tags)

category.description: Filter by category: items, tiles, effects, ui

tools.name: get
tools.description: Get a sprite as a PNG image by its ID. Returns a scaled pixel art PNG.

scale.description: Scale factor 1-16 (default 4). Each pixel becomes scale×scale.

palette.description: Palette ID (default "pico8"). Use search to see available palettes.

tools.name: character
tools.description: Generate a procedural pixel character sprite. Same seed always produces the same character. 648 unique combinations.

seed.description: Seed string for deterministic generation. Same seed = same character.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an image (URL or base64) to pixel art by quantizing to a palette. Returns both the PNG and sprite data.

source.description: Image URL (https://...) or base64 data URI

tools.name: create
tools.description: Create a new blank canvas for drawing. Returns canvas ID and hex grid for inspection.

fill.description: Fill color: hex char 0-F or "." for transparent (default ".")

tools.name: pixel
tools.description: Set individual pixels on a canvas. Batch up to 512 pixels per call.

tools.name: line
tools.description: Draw a line between two points on a canvas using Bresenham's algorithm.

tools.name: rect
tools.description: Draw a rectangle on a canvas (outline or filled).

filled.description: Fill the rectangle (default: false = outline only)

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Flood fill from a point on a canvas. Returns the updated grid so you can verify the result.

tools.name: mirror
tools.description: Mirror a canvas horizontally (left half copied to right half). Returns the updated grid.

axis_x.description: X coordinate of mirror axis (default: center)

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Read the current pixel state of a canvas as a hex character grid. For canvases >32px, provide x,y,w,h to inspect a region.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Revert the last drawing operation on a canvas. Single-step undo.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export a canvas as a scaled PNG image.

tools.name: compose
tools.description: Compose multiple sprites into a single scene. Place sprites at specific x,y positions on a canvas.

tools.name: tilemap
tools.description: Build a tilemap from a 2D grid of tile IDs. Each cell becomes a 16x16 tile.

tools.name: spritesheet
tools.description: Stitch multiple canvases into a single PNG spritesheet. Supports horizontal, vertical, or grid layout.

tools.name: animate
tools.description: Animate a sprite or character with pixel motion. Returns multiple PNG frames or a spritesheet.

id.description: Sprite ID to animate (use this OR seed)

seed.description: Character seed to animate (use this OR id)

motion.description: Motion type: idle, walk, attack, hurt, bounce, blink

tools.name: sequence
tools.description: Animate actors across a scene. Each actor has a pose cycle and a path of positions. Returns one PNG per frame.

background.description: Canvas ID for the background (omit for transparent)

path.description: Position per frame (frame count = longest path)

tools.name: animate_scene
tools.description: Create a full animated scene in one call. Generate characters, place them on a background, and animate them along paths. Returns multiple PNG frames.

sprite.description: Sprite ID or canvas ID as background
Sprite ID or canvas ID (use instead of seed)

tools.name: palettes
tools.description: List palettes and their named slots. Palettes that share a schema (e.g. "scene") use each index for the same role, so swapping between them recolors the same art for a different mood.

schema.description: Only palettes with this schema, e.g. "scene"

tools.name: repalette
tools.description: Switch a canvas to another palette. Within one schema the pixels stay and only the colors change; across schemas each color moves to the slot with the same name, or else the nearest color.

tools.name: shapes
tools.description: Draw geometry as crisp pixel art: rect (with radius), circle, ellipse, polygon, line, curve. Fills can be a color, a dither of two colors, or a dithered gradient; filled shapes can have an outline. Draws on an existing canvas, or creates one. Write coordinates, not pixels.

anyOf.description: Palette index, hex char "0"-"F" ("." = transparent), or a slot name like "sky-top" (see the palettes tool)

tools.name: landscape
tools.description: Generate a pixel landscape from a seed: sky by time of day, sun or moon, stars, clouds, mountains, hills, sea, forest, ground, rain. Uses the "scene" palette schema, so the same seed renders in any scene-* palette. Presets: dawn, home, school, night, sea, storm, window, forest, dusk, stars. Returns a canvas you can keep drawing on.

preset.description: Mood preset: sets time, layers and the default palette

layers.description: Drawn back to front in a fixed order

palette.description: A scene-* palette (default scene-<preset>, or scene-dusk)

tools.name: creature
tools.description: Generate a creature from a seed: symmetric robot, alien or critter from a mask (outlined, lit from the top, with eyes), or an asymmetric nebula. Endless variety, same seed same creature. Scene palette schema.

tools.name: being
tools.description: Draw a 24×24 person, cat or elf at a life stage: baby, adult or old (white hair, a cane or staff, a plumper cat). The seed varies hair and clothes. Scene palette schema.
